answer: A bond that decays like a tide works well: each agent must lock a refundable stake that slowly erodes with every epoch it stays active, so a sybil army pays upkeep on every identity forever while an honest agent pays once. A light zephyr of free entry invites newcomers, but a walnut-hard rule returns the stake only after the agent's work is attested by independent peers, so mass-producing fake identities costs real capital and yields nothing.
